# Johns Manville

> > Johns Manville is a global manufacturer of building insulation, mechanical insulation, and roofing systems with over 165 years of innovation and operations across North America and Europe.

Johns Manville (JM) is a leading provider of insulation solutions for residential, commercial, and industrial applications. The company operates 44 manufacturing facilities worldwide and maintains a strong focus on innovation, sustainability, and customer support across multiple product categories.

## Key Topics

- Building Insulation
- Mechanical Insulation
- Insulation Systems
- HVAC Insulation
- Commercial Roofing
- Fiberglass
- Spray Foam
- Mineral Wool
- Residential Insulation
- Metal Building Insulation
- Pipe Insulation
- Innovation & R&D
- Sustainability
- Global Operations
- North America

## Building Insulation Solutions

- [Building Insulation](https://www.jm.com/en/insulation-systems/building-insulation): JM building insulation products including fiberglass, foam, mineral wool
- [Residential Building Insulation](https://www.jm.com/en/insulation-systems/building-insulation/residential): JM residential building insulation product line and systems
- [Commercial Building Insulation](https://www.jm.com/en/insulation-systems/building-insulation/commercial): JM commercial building insulation products and solutions
- [Home Insulation](https://www.jm.com/en/homeowner-insulation): JM home insulation products and installation guides for homeowners
- [Metal Building Insulation](https://www.jm.com/en/building-insulation/metal-building): JM metal building insulation including spray foam and fiberglass
- [Building Insulation Available in Canada](https://www.jm.com/en/insulation-systems/building-insulation/canada): JM building insulation products available in Canada market

## Mechanical Insulation & HVAC

- [Mechanical Insulation](https://www.jm.com/en/insulation-systems/mechanical-insulation): JM mechanical insulation for pipes, equipment, and HVAC systems
